figure.title: Five slices and what blocks them

s1.name: Post a report
s1.subtitle: Check: round trip
s1.description: Slice 1. A hiker posts a report and it shows on that trail page. Nothing blocks it, so it starts first. The check posts a report and reads it back.

s2.name: List a trail's reports
s2.subtitle: Check: newest first
s2.description: Slice 2. A trail page lists its reports, newest first. It waits for slice 1. The check seeds three reports and reads the order.

s4.name: Flag a wrong report
s4.subtitle: Check: two flags hide it
s4.description: Slice 4. Two flags hide a report. It waits for slice 1 only, so it can run beside slice 2. The check flags a stored report twice.

s3.name: Hide old reports
s3.subtitle: Check: fixed clock
s3.description: Slice 3. Reports older than 14 days drop off the page. It waits for slice 2. The check runs with a fixed clock.

s5.name: Weekly digest
s5.subtitle: Check: fixed sample
s5.description: Slice 5. A weekly text summary of recent reports. It waits for slices 2 and 3. The check compares the digest of fixed sample data with the expected text.
